AssalamAlaikum Respected Mufti Saab, Since the construction of our masjid ten years ago, the qibla was assumed to be exactly eastwards i.e 90 degrees clockwise. (using a standard 360 degree rotation) Using more accurate and reliable calculations, we have calculated the qibla again and it is in fact 66.52 degrees clockwise. It means therefore that our present qibla direction is off by approximately 23.48 degrees to the actual qibla. Is this amount of variation allowed? What should we do henceforth? An urgant reply will be most appreciated as this issue is of utmost importance to our entire community. JazakAllah. 3077 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 60811 Country: India Title: Dismantle or renovation of old mosque Question: We have an old mosque in village Anwarabad, Sonai, Mathura which is small and on the verge of collapse. We are scared for dismantling it as it might be against Islamic law. Kindly advise for its dismantle and erecting new spacious mosque or we should retain its present structure and renovate it. The program has been held for want of authentic opinion. Answer ID: 60811 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 678/678/SD=11/1436) If it is feared that the old mosque will collapse down then the people of locality may demolish it and construct big and concrete mosque again. According to Shariah the people of the locality are allowed to do so. أما أهل المحلة فلهم أن يهدموا ويجددوا بناءه ويفرشوا الحصير – الخ – (الفتاوى الهندية: 2/457، كتاب الوقف ، الفصل الرابع في المسجد واوقافه) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
